terms.heading: 12. Transaction records and connected automations
paragraphs: MOVO is a recordkeeping application, not a bank account or a payment instruction service. Manually entered expenses, incoming payments, scheduled items and phone-automation logs reflect information supplied or approved by you; they do not prove that a bank, merchant or card issuer has settled a transaction. MOVO does not initiate, cancel or reverse a payment at your bank.

Phone automations and imported records may be delayed, incomplete, duplicated or misclassified. Verify amounts, currencies, payment accounts, billing cycles and reference numbers against your bank or card statements before relying on them. Deleting a MOVO record does not reverse a real-world purchase or payment.

terms.heading: 13. Balances, investments and currency estimates
paragraphs: Balances, credit utilisation, debts, forecasts, savings projections, cryptocurrency values and stock quotes are informational estimates derived from records and third-party reference data. Pending transactions can affect available funds differently from settled balances. Market prices and currency conversions may be delayed, indicative or unavailable, and are not executable quotes.

MOVO does not provide regulated investment, credit, legal, tax or professional accounting advice. You remain responsible for reconciling MOVO records, checking important figures and making financial decisions. Never treat a displayed forecast as a guaranteed return or a promise that funds are available.

terms.heading: 14. Paid subscriptions, restoration and refunds
paragraphs: If paid features become available through the iOS or Android app, the relevant app store displays the applicable price, billing period, trial terms and any taxes before you confirm a purchase. Eligible subscriptions renew automatically according to the terms shown by that store unless cancelled there. The store manages payment processing, billing changes, cancellation and applicable refund requests; MOVO cannot cancel your store subscription merely by deleting your MOVO account.

Restore Purchases can restore an eligible, verified purchase to the MOVO account originally linked to it. Restores and access depend on valid store verification, account matching and product availability. Refunds and statutory consumer rights are determined under applicable law and the relevant store rules. MOVO will not describe disabled checkout as a functioning purchase option.

Cancelling renewal normally preserves verified paid access until the current paid period expires, unless a refund, revocation or another lawful store action changes that access. A MOVO promotional trial does not by itself authorize a charge. A store-managed trial may renew at the price and interval shown by the store unless cancelled under those terms. Contact MOVO for access or verification problems; mandatory consumer rights still apply.

terms.heading: 15. Security, service changes and user responsibilities
paragraphs: Use a secure device, protect sign-in codes and recovery channels, and do not share bank passwords, card PINs, CVVs or one-time passcodes with MOVO. Exported CSV files and screenshots may expose sensitive financial records. A device-level passcode or convenience app lock is not a substitute for account authentication or encryption of local browser storage.

We may temporarily restrict a feature to prevent misuse, investigate a security incident or comply with applicable law. Where required, we will provide applicable notices and respect non-waivable consumer and privacy rights. No provision here restricts rights that cannot legally be excluded.

terms.heading: 16. Third-party content and support
paragraphs: Bank and payment-network names, merchant logos and product names may belong to their respective owners and do not imply partnership or endorsement. Market-data and AI services can provide information that is incomplete or unavailable. Third-party services may have additional terms.

To report an inaccurate calculation, disputed purchase entitlement, unauthorized access or data-handling concern, contact support@nasrinai.com. Include the affected feature and relevant non-secret details only; do not email passwords, one-time codes or full card numbers.

terms.heading: 17. Accepting these terms during setup
paragraphs: During setup, and after a material policy revision, MOVO asks you to agree to the Terms and acknowledge the Privacy Policy before the app opens. Optional AI sharing and device permissions require their own choices. The accepted revision and acceptance time are saved in your device preferences and, when signed in, supported account preferences.

The guide shown during setup uses screenshots with invented sample records, not anyone's real financial data. Logos that appear in it are shown only to identify the type of record, as described in section 16.

terms.heading: 18. Sharing with friends
paragraphs: Only share content you have the right to share. MOVO prohibits harassment, threats, sexually exploitative material, nonconsensual intimate imagery (including AI-generated imagery), impersonation, fraud, and disclosure of someone else’s private information through Friends. A shared transaction card is a record, not a payment instruction. Block a user or report a request or shared summary in the app; where message-specific reporting is available, report the received message. Contact support@nasrinai.com for help and safety concerns.

privacy.heading: 10. Why we process information and the applicable basis
paragraphs: We use the information you provide to deliver requested tracking, authentication, cloud sync, transaction logging, support and exports; to maintain service integrity and prevent misuse; and to meet legal obligations where applicable. Depending on the processing and the law that applies, these activities may rely on your request or agreement, legitimate interests that do not override your rights, legal obligations or your consent where required.

Optional financial-context sharing with NasrinAI and its configured providers requires a separate in-app choice. You may decline and continue manual tracking. This device’s chat and voice consent can be withdrawn in Settings → Security & Privacy → AI data sharing. Already submitted material and other devices are handled as described in section 5.

privacy.heading: 11. Service providers and external requests
paragraphs: Cloud-enabled functions use infrastructure and authentication providers, including Vercel and Supabase, which may process the account, financial and technical records needed to operate the service. When you request NasrinAI features, your message and permitted user-scoped context may be processed by NasrinAI and the AI or voice providers used to deliver that feature. Store-purchase verification may involve Apple or Google.

Market prices, currency reference data, icon/favicon services and linked third-party content can involve requests to external services. Depending on the feature and how it is loaded, those services may receive network information such as an IP address, browser or app request metadata. MOVO does not need your bank password or card security code to maintain manually entered transaction records.

Providers may process data outside the Philippines. Appropriate safeguards and applicable contractual or legal protections must be evaluated for international transfers; the operator must keep its processor list and transfer assessment current.

privacy.heading: 12. Device permissions, receipts and voice
paragraphs: Camera or photo access is used only for optional scanning, attachment or visual features when permitted by your device. The app may process some images locally and may save receipt attachments in owner-restricted cloud storage if you explicitly attach them. Uploaded receipts can contain sensitive merchant, account or personal information, so review images before attaching.

Microphone access is used for voice features when you activate them. Short voice clips may be sent to transcription or voice-response providers to fulfil the request. Permission can be withdrawn through device settings, although the voice feature may then stop working. Do not assume third-party provider retention practices are identical to MOVO's local storage.

privacy.heading: 13. Security and account separation
paragraphs: MOVO uses account authentication, database access controls and transport-security measures for applicable cloud services. These are designed to reduce unauthorized access, but no internet or device storage can be guaranteed completely secure. A local app lock is a convenience control and does not itself encrypt records or replace server authentication. Finance-vault encryption, where available, is a separate safeguard.

Only provide information necessary for the function you choose. Protect your phone and account access, sign out of shared devices and avoid putting passwords, PINs, CVVs or one-time passcodes in chat prompts, receipts or support requests. Security incidents and legally notifiable breaches are handled according to applicable law.

privacy.heading: 14. How long data stays and how deletion works
paragraphs: Retention varies by record, storage location and the deletion function used. The record-specific Archive limits, local copies, Clear records scope and account-deletion exceptions are described in section 6; the 90-day cleanup window is not a universal retention period or a guaranteed scheduled purge.

Use Settings → Delete Account in MOVO or the public account-deletion page to request removal of your cloud account and associated personal data. Local data on another device may need separate clearing. Some data may remain temporarily in backups, security logs or records that must lawfully be retained for accounting, fraud prevention, dispute resolution or legal claims; such exceptions should be limited to applicable purposes and retention requirements. Deleting MOVO does not cancel an Apple or Google subscription.

Backup, incident and legally retained records may have different retention periods depending on the underlying service and legal obligations. This notice does not promise immediate removal from every backup or third-party system; contact our privacy team to ask about a particular record.

privacy.heading: 15. Your choices and privacy rights
paragraphs: Where applicable, you may ask to be informed about processing, access or correct personal data, object to qualifying processing, withdraw consent, request deletion or blocking, obtain a portable copy, and raise a complaint with the appropriate regulator. You may export available financial records in MOVO and contact support@nasrinai.com for additional requests.

We may need to verify your identity before disclosing or deleting cloud records. We will assess requests under the applicable law, including lawful retention exceptions, without asking you to email passwords or full payment-card information.

Contact dpo@nasrinai.com to exercise these rights. Where the GDPR applies, requests are normally answered within one month; a legally permitted extension is explained within that first month. Other applicable legal deadlines still govern. Requests are normally free, subject to lawful exceptions. You may complain to a competent regulator without contacting MOVO first.

privacy.heading: 16. AI assistance and automated inferences
paragraphs: Optional AI-generated summaries, classifications, suggestions and market insights may be incorrect or biased and are provided for review, not as automatic financial instructions. MOVO's suggestions do not independently authorize a payment, apply for credit or make a binding lending or insurance decision on your behalf.

If you do not enable NasrinAI's financial-context sharing, that optional data sharing should not occur. Contact support if you believe information was shared without authorization, or if you want to exercise your rights in relation to a recommendation.

privacy.heading: 17. Children, policy updates and operator information
paragraphs: MOVO is intended for adults aged 18 or older. Age eligibility and privacy-contact details are set out in sections 1 and 9.

MOVO is a product of NasrinAI. Material changes will be dated and communicated as required. Acceptance of the Terms and acknowledgement of the Privacy Policy are separate from optional AI and device-permission choices; a policy update does not by itself authorize new optional processing.

privacy.heading: 18. Referral codes and download links
paragraphs: Each signed-in MOVO account has a short referral code, for example M78038. Your code is part of your Refer MOVO download links and QR codes. It identifies the account that shared the link and contains no name, email address or financial information.

When someone opens your Android link, Google Play receives the code as part of the store address and keeps it as the app’s install referrer. On its first launch, the MOVO Android app asks Google Play for that referrer once, on the device, and keeps only a valid referral code, which is filled in so the person can add it after signing in. On iPhone, the download page shows the code and copies it to the clipboard only when its button is tapped.

A referral code counts only after the person signs in and the MOVO service accepts it. MOVO then records which account referred which, and any referral points, with both accounts. Referral codes are not used for advertising.

MOVO uses Apple App Attest or Google Play Integrity to confirm that the official app was used for the referral. MOVO records the linked accounts, verification result, confirmed store payment or refund status, and points earned or used. The referral process does not collect your payment card details.

privacy.heading: 19. AI receipt scanning and categorization
paragraphs: When you choose Analyze with AI on a receipt photo, MOVO sends that selected photo, or extracted text from a PDF receipt, to the MOVO server and its configured AI provider (OpenRouter and the underlying model provider) to read merchant, date, item, amount, tax and payment fields and suggest categories. MOVO requests that its AI provider not collect prompts for training, but provider handling, cross-border processing and retention remain subject to applicable service terms and laws. Do not include passwords, PINs, card verification codes, one-time passcodes or unrelated people's information in receipts.

AI receipt scanning requires sign-in, qualifying access and a separate in-app confirmation for each receipt. You can decline and instead use basic on-device text recognition, or discard the scan without creating a financial transaction. MOVO does not store the scanned photo or full source text in its AI proxy or provider request logs. When you select Log, the details you approve become a MOVO transaction under your selected account, which may sync to your cloud account under your chosen storage settings. The provider may process the submitted receipt as needed to return the result; cancelling or deleting the MOVO review does not guarantee removal from third-party systems.

If the receipt and selected payment account use different currencies, MOVO downloads general exchange rates from ExchangeRate-API and calculates an estimate on your device. The rate request carries no receipt, amount, account, or sign-in data. A bank or card statement may show a different amount. If you log the transaction, MOVO saves the original receipt total and the conversion or statement amount with the transaction.

AI-extracted fields and categories can be wrong. MOVO shows a summary for review, allows correction, and does not choose your bank, card, e-wallet or cash account on your behalf. VAT included in a total, cash tendered and change are not separate transactions. You remain responsible for checking the logged amount, currency, date, merchant, categories, payment account and any duplicates before relying on reports.

privacy.heading: 20. Private friend invites
paragraphs: Friends is optional. To create or accept an invite, sign in and choose the display name you want to share. Anyone who has an active invite link and a verified MOVO account can see the name attached to that invite. Invite links carry a random code and expire after 24 hours or after one person accepts. Creating a replacement or revoking the active invite disables the previous link.

MOVO stores a hashed invite code, account identifiers, chosen display names, usernames, requests and connection timestamps to manage Friends. Verified members can search usernames that their owners choose to make discoverable. The search shows only usernames. Recipients choose whether to accept connection requests.

When you preview and approve a monthly tracking summary, MOVO stores the selected snapshot for the friend you chose. The sections you select may include your note, income, expenses, savings balance, weekly net cash flow, financial planning totals, budget and plan progress, and spending category percentages. Friends cannot open your underlying transactions, receipts or accounts. You can revoke access, and removing a friend removes any shared snapshots for that connection.

MOVO stores an uploaded account profile photo for signed-in users and makes it available on their devices. Accepted Friends connections can receive that profile photo in the inbox and conversation. Search results and shared summaries do not include your photo, email or contacts. Guests keep their photo on the current device. Account deletion removes the account photo and associated Friends records, subject to the retention exceptions described in this policy.

When you send a private Friends message, MOVO stores the message, sender and connection identifiers, timestamps and read state to deliver the conversation to the accepted connection. If you choose to share a transaction card, selected financial fields are stored with the message and shown to that recipient. A recipient must explicitly choose whether to import the record and select their own account; MOVO does not transfer funds. Recipients may keep copies they have already received or imported.

If you block or report someone, MOVO stores the accounts involved and the type of report for safety and support review. Where message-specific reports are enabled, MOVO records the connection and message identifiers. A report does not copy the contents of a financial summary into the report record.

When you choose Scan QR code, MOVO reads camera frames or a selected QR photo on your device. These images are not uploaded or stored by Friends. Only a validated MOVO invitation code is sent for review; scanning does not accept the invite automatically. You can instead paste an invite link. A profile QR image you choose to share contains your chosen display name, initial and temporary invitation code, without your photo, contact details or financial records. Recipients and sharing apps may keep a copy; revoking the invite disables its code, not those copies.
